decisions.packFormat: VCS four-card packs, 36 packs per box. Physical hobby packs had 10 cards.
decisions.collation: One universal pack. Series odds are weighted by 275/517 and 242/517 and rounded to whole denominators. Channel-exclusive inserts stay available at their weighted channel odds.
decisions.baseStructure: One 517-card Base checklist with equal base availability. Four independently numbered 110-card Dugout and Artist’s Proof checklists.
decisions.reflextions: Use 20 numbered entries from both checklists. The 18 in the BaseballCardPedia odds table conflicts with its own checklist.
decisions.rookieLabels: Use TCDB’s eight recognized true rookie cards, only on Base. Rookie-themed subset cards such as Derek Jeter #240 do not receive RC.
decisions.exclusions: Exclude the two separately distributed Samples promotional checklists.
